aim: Link continuous-time trajectories, finite-window reporter observation, calibration uncertainty and sequential power
initialization: Independent draws from each arm periodic boundary distribution; numerical distributions independently checked
mc_reporting: Pointwise 95% and simultaneous Bonferroni 95% Clopper-Pearson intervals; seed-specific counts retained
validation_error_budget: 1/1000 for bounded moment and exact-power reference envelopes
sampling: Fresh independent paired trajectories for every block; shared paths across declared window/method comparisons, no empirical-pool resampling
biological_status: Declared stochastic kinetic and bounded linear reporter models; no measured cellular data or calibrated biological time units
runtime: C++17 event-driven CTMC; Python3.12 numpy2.2.6 scipy1.15.3 for numerical moment references and binomial intervals
failure_policy: Retain every scenario and seed; no outcome-driven grid changes or selective reruns
